findings.message: 2 window flags do not match the size of the neighboring block: the first, in the packet at 0xEB, gives a short previous block where it is long. Decoders shape the window by the flag (section 4.3.1), so the overlapping halves differ.
1 audio packet names a mode the setup header does not define, or ends before the mode and window flags; decoders skip it (section 4.3.1). The first at 0xF0.
1 packet after the headers has the packet type bit set, so it is not audio; decoders skip it (section 4.3.1). The first at 0xF1.
1 audio packet is empty; decoders skip it. The first at 0xFC.
